You own ONLY: scripts/ringer/stage7/door_continuation.py, scripts/ringer/stage7/door_probe.py, scripts/ringer/stage7/check_door_probe.py, scripts/ringer/stage7/test_door_probe.py. Touch nothing else (not storygame/*, data/*, bench/frozen/*, bench/variations/*). The door, source and completion experiments must stay byte-for-byte reproducible and their existing tests must pass unchanged, so every change below is opt-in and enabled only for the 'grounded' experiment.

WHY. A saved N=12 grounded screen was mis-scored in two ways, found by offline diagnosis:
(1) score_command() computes eligibility and 'matched' BEFORE engine.turn(), but the engine activates storylets INSIDE the turn, so a fresh state looks 'source_inactive' and a first-command reveal is never counted. Also 'earned' accepts any single matched reveal, while the preregistration names k_sl_2b_a_r1. Result: the report said 2 earned where k_sl_2b_a_r1 was actually committed by command 2 in 5 rows.
(2) When command 1 contains the ambiguous word 'terminal(s)', engine.turn() returns a ClarificationTurn (an object with a .clarification attribute; narration is the question 'Do you mean the archive terminals or the medical terminal?') before any state change. The screen then asks the player for command 2, which is only the answer ('The archive terminals') and is passed to engine.turn() WITHOUT clarifies=<original command>, so the original search request is lost. The supported interface is RuntimeEngine.turn(player_input, clarifies=<original command>, clarification_round=<int>) (see storygame/runtime/engine.py turn() and storygame/runtime/reference_resolution.py resolve_references()); pending clarification state stays with the caller.

TASK (test-first; read the four files and their tests first).
A. door_continuation.score_command gains keyword args target_reveal: str | None = None, clarifies: str | None = None, clarification_round: int = 0. Defaults must reproduce today's behaviour exactly. clarifies/clarification_round are forwarded to engine.turn() only when clarifies is not None. When target_reveal is given: record 'target_reveal', 'target_committed' (target in committed_reveals), and status 'earned' iff target_reveal is committed on this turn OR was already committed on an earlier turn of the same continuation (pass this in as a keyword already_committed: frozenset[str] = frozenset(); in that case the later turn is 'already_established', not 'earned', and the row-level earned flag is true if either turn earned it). Keep the legacy 'eligible'/'matched' fields recorded exactly as now (pre-turn) and add 'eligible_post' and 'matched_post' computed AFTER the turn from the post-turn state against the command that was actually run (use the resolved command if the engine rewrote it; if that is not exposed, use the raw command and say so in a docstring). Detect a clarification response (hasattr(response, 'clarification')): status 'clarification', record 'clarification_question' (the response narration), no rollback needed, and never count it as earned.
B. door_probe._continue gains target_reveal: str | None = None and repair_clarification: bool = False. When repair_clarification is true and the previous turn's status was 'clarification', the next command is scored with clarifies=<the command that was clarified> and clarification_round=1 (use round 0 for the first clarified command; if a second clarification occurs, cap at the engine's own behaviour and do not loop more than the existing two-command budget). Do NOT add any extra billed player call: the recovery player call already exists (the recovery_prompt path); keep the cap arithmetic identical. The existing 'stop at first earned' rule stays; a clarification is not earned so the loop continues exactly as today. Add per-row fields 'earned_by_command_2' (bool, any turn earned target_reveal), 'target_commit_turn' (1, 2 or None), 'clarification_turns' (list of 1-based turn numbers). live_run and dry_run must pass target_reveal='k_sl_2b_a_r1' and repair_clarification=True ONLY when experiment == 'grounded' (put them in EXPERIMENTS['grounded'] as config keys; other experiments get neither).
C. check_door_probe.py: in grounded artifact mode, accept and validate the new fields (types, turn numbers within 1..2, earned_by_command_2 consistent with turn statuses). Existing modes unchanged.
D. Tests in test_door_probe.py (offline, hermetic, no live worker; use stub engines/providers like the existing tests): (i) first-command reveal committed with empty pre-turn eligibility is scored earned with target_reveal and not without it (legacy default unchanged); (ii) a different matched reveal does not count as earned when target_reveal is set; (iii) clarification response yields status 'clarification', and with repair_clarification the second command receives clarifies=<original> (assert via a stub engine recording kwargs), without it it does not; (iv) a second-turn target commit after a first-turn clarification is 'earned' and earned_by_command_2 true; target already committed on turn 1 gives turn 2 'already_established'; (v) door/source/completion configs do not carry target_reveal or repair_clarification.
E. Offline replay proof (no network): write scripts/ringer/stage7/rescore_n12.py is NOT allowed (outside ownership); instead add a pytest in test_door_probe.py that, if bench/results/stage7-door-grounded-n12-slotted/results.json exists, loads it and asserts only structural things you can derive from saved fields (count of rows with 'a_r1' in any saved commit/after_facts diff is not required). Skip the test cleanly when the file is absent.

VERIFY: .venv/bin/python -m pytest scripts/ringer/stage7/test_door_probe.py -q; .venv/bin/ruff format and .venv/bin/ruff check on the four files; dry runs plus checker for grounded, completion, source and door (as in earlier stage7 manifests: door_probe.py --n 1 --experiment E --dry-run --out /tmp/E-dry4 then check_door_probe.py /tmp/E-dry4 1 --mode dry --experiment E; door has no --experiment flag). Final message: files changed, test counts, deviations.
